targetReason: site/ is static HTML with no build step, rsync-deployed by deploy/setup-site.sh, with 8 generated locales. The Layers starter is not applicable; we take the portable single-HTML master and translate it in.

style.why: Closest match to Vault's existing tokens.css: hairline blueprint structure, zero shadows, near-flat radii, mono for every label, and one blue ramp used only on instruments.

overrides.note: Vault's brand spine outranks the Style for colour and type. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-18-brand-spine-design.md and CLAUDE.md § Design assets.
overrides.fonts: Manrope + IBM Plex Mono, self-hosted from site/fonts/. Evolve's Inter Tight / Space Mono are NOT adopted: every Layers Style ships a Google Fonts URL and Vault must render with no third-party origin.
overrides.palette: site/styles.css tokens are authoritative. Scenes and gradients are tinted to them through CONFIG, never by editing a shader.
overrides.brandBlue: #1257c4 is pinned by web/tests/brandspine.test.ts and must not move.

plan.hero: astragal gradient (lattice, cost: light) tinted to Vault blue, behind the existing live telemetry rail
plan.choreography: Layers house reveal: loader -> gate -> staggered reveal, honouring prefers-reduced-motion
plan.scene: one scene lower down the page, lazy-mounted so it cannot delay first paint
plan.budget: subtle, per Evolve's own motionEnergy axis

constraints.vendoring: Every borrowed asset is downloaded into the repo. No CDN, no hotlink to storage.getlayers.ai, no Google Fonts link.
constraints.locales: site/index.html is the only hand-edited copy. After any change run: python3 site/i18n/build_locales.py
constraints.copyBudget: 115 assert-pinned strings. `live` (1), `capabilities` (0), `caps` (3) and `how` (4) are cheap; `access` (25) and `integrations` (15) are expensive.

placed.tint: Vault ramp: --bg / --panel / --line / --deep / --acc. The GetLayers-derived Evolve tint was refused: its mid-stop #ff1f4a is a red, and red on a Vault surface means an alert.
placed.preserved: motion + composition, per the asset's contract
adaptations: authoring panel stripped (19 elements, ~370 lines)
WebGL2 fallback made silent — upstream covers the viewport with a notice
prefers-reduced-motion handled in JS; a canvas loop escapes the CSS rule
buffer and pointer measure the canvas, not the window
ResizeObserver added: the hero is content-sized
scrim flattened below 900px where the hero becomes one column
light skin: a CONFIG-level tint (window.__GUARDIAN_HERO_TINT merged before applyConfig) gives the calm skin a white ground and a blue lattice; the shader is untouched, the dark ramp is untouched
scrim and #hero-fade read --bg plus a --veil RGB triplet flipped by an is-light class, so the same gradient stops serve both skins
skin change remounts the scene: the canvas node is replaced, #hero-fade reset to opacity 1, the tint global reset, the script re-appended -- CONFIG is read once at start

placed.asset: reveal choreography (house pattern, not a catalog asset)
adaptations: no loader and no progress counter — the guide's own 'be honest about what you are measuring' rules one out on a static page with nothing to measure
the hero's existing lattice veil is the gate; it flips at the start of the exit, not on its rest
nothing hides unless the script runs, per the site's no-JS rule in app.js
elements selected by class, never marked with a data- attribute, because the locale generator pins whole tags
no clipped reveals: both Evolve's contract and the guide forbid clipping a blurred entrance

placed.asset: Quiet Watch — ORIGINAL, authored via getlayers_scene_lab
placed.depicts: a field of devices at rest; one goes quiet, a ring of attention passes through its neighbours, it recovers
adaptations: plain WebGL2 instead of Scene Lab's three.js + CDN importmap: Vault reaches no third-party origin, and vendoring three.js with post-processing is ~0.75MB to draw dots
CONFIG contract kept in full: colours are '#rrggbb' strings, every other knob a number, applied to uniforms never to the shader
palette limited to --bg / --deep / --acc; no red and no green, which mean alert and good on every Vault surface
lazy: mounts on intersection, stops on exit
reduced motion draws one complete frame mid-event, so the ring is visible and static
light skin: window.__GUARDIAN_WATCH_TINT merged into CONFIG before applyConfig (bgColor white, pointColor --deep, liveColor --fg); shader untouched
how-scrim reads --bg plus --veil, flipped by is-light on #how
skin change remounts the scene the same way as the hero

sceneDecision.status: resolved — nothing in the catalog fit, so an original was authored (see placed[])
sceneDecision.why: The scene catalog is built for other kinds of product. The closest candidates are actively wrong for a security vendor: 'thorned-halo' is a crown of thorns with 'quiet religious weight'; 'luminous-saucer' draws a figure up into the night; 'candle-aurora' is a finance chart whose green would collide with green=good; 'grain-cubes' is acid risograph. 'halftone-iris' is the interesting near-miss — a sapphire eye that blinks and follows you, correctly dark and technical, and exactly the wrong connotation: Vault protects the owner's network, and an eye watching the reader reads as the thing they are buying protection from.
sceneDecision.toneTrap: Several otherwise-plausible scenes ('argent-massif', 'aether-flux', 'blocky-grid') ship only light-tone rolls. The combination rules say a scene's tone never flips, because its contrast is baked into the shader: re-skinning a light scene dark turns it to mud.
options: getlayers_scene_lab — author an original scene for Vault
leave the page as it is: lattice plus choreography
